text:
sam (AE): Pinewave wants a short POC to validate performance and cost. Workload: conv+retrieval (70% chat gen avg 256 tokens, 30% chunk embedding). Target sustained 500 qps, three 45s spikes to 3k qps, p95 gen <=200ms. KMS + VPC peering required. Sketch run plan + ballpark monthly cost?
viv (Solutions Eng): Need to pin models (13B vs 70B), embed dim (1536), and confirm retrieval batching. Propose: 20m smoke, 45m ramp to 500 qps, 1h steady, 3 spikes 45s @3k spaced 4m. Gen max_tokens=256, embed batch_size=32. Will run 13B primary and 70B fallback.
drew (SRE): VPC peering + NAT hops -> expect ~6-10ms network overhead. KMS adds ~7-12ms on cold keys; recommend warmup. Enable continuous KV cache, set batching window to 20ms.
sam (AE): Run it and share artifacts.
viv (Solutions Eng): Running harness: rbench run --scenario conv-retrieval --gen-model rwd-13b-q4 --embed-model rwd-embed-1536 --qps 500 --burst 3000 --dur 7200 --batch-embed 32 --max-tokens 256 --warmup 120
(deploy-bot): Job started: bench-3067890123-pinewave (trace: TB-9012). Artifacts: https://redwood.internal/bench/3067890123
viv (Solutions Eng): First pass (13B) steady 500 qps: gen median=98ms, p95=215ms, p99=420ms. Embeds median=18ms. Spikes caused p95 -> 560ms.
sam (AE): 215ms too high. Fixes?
viv (Solutions Eng): Tried bumping batching window: median +6ms, p95 -> 185ms. Pre-warm KV and models reduced spike tail. Combined changes produced median=110ms, p95=180ms, p99=320ms. Embeds unchanged.
anya (Product): We'll run a 200-sample side-by-side quality eval and retrieval precision check. Attach notes to the deck.
drew (SRE): Measured KMS+VPC overhead ~12ms added; recommend 2-minute warmup during cutover and client retry/backoff for 5xx. No infra compliance blockers; will prepare VPC/key-flow diagram and short ISO-controls FAQ.
sam (AE): Pricing ask: monthly for 150M gen tokens + 10M embeds + occasional spikes.
viv (Solutions Eng): Ballpark hosted estimate: Gen compute for 150M on 13B ~$27k/mo, Embeds 10M ~$2.4k/mo, Burst buffer & reserved capacity $6.5k/mo, KMS & networking premium $1k/mo. Total ~ $37k/mo. If fallback to 70B used for some fraction, add ~+$10k depending on mix. I'll drop a detailed spreadsheet in prospect folder.
sam (AE): Need 1-slide summary + spreadsheet by EOD + bench artifacts and quality eval attached.
viv (Solutions Eng): Uploaded artifacts: https://redwood.internal/assets/pinewave/bench_artifacts_3067890123.zip (results, histograms, spreadsheet, runbook). Runbook excerpt: warmup loop, canary routing snippet, suggested client retry/backoff.
sam (AE): Scheduling demo Tue 11am PT. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
